# CHUMBAKA

> CHUMBAKA is a Malaysia-based STEM education platform providing coding and programming classes for kids and teens, combining technology skills with life skills development through project-based learning and innovation competitions.

Founded in 2015, CHUMBAKA operates multiple learning centers across Malaysia and offers online classes, school partnerships, and community innovation programs. The organization focuses on building future-ready youth through hands-on coding, IoT, and AI projects while fostering entrepreneurship and social impact.

## Key Topics

- Coding & Programming
- STEM Education
- IoT Projects
- Arduino
- Life Skills Development

- [Kuching](https://www.chumbaka.asia/chumbaka-in-kuching): CHUMBAKA Kuching location: STEM coding classes at Canaan Square Business Hub
- [Kota Kinabalu](https://www.chumbaka.asia/chumbaka-in-kota-kinabalu): CHUMBAKA Kota Kinabalu: digital making education & IoT at Plaza YLY
- [Malacca](https://www.chumbaka.asia/chumbaka-in-malacca): CHUMBAKA Malacca location: technology & life skills coding education
